The plot illustrates the performance comparison of different models, specifically StrmLLM and SepLLM with various configurations, as represented by distinct lines on the graph. The x-axis is unlabeled but has a linear scale, spanning from approximately 0 to 1000 with tick labels at intervals of 200, and the y-axis is also unlabeled with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to a value slightly above 1 with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The graph features five lines, each representing a different model configuration: StrmLLM (n=64) in blue with a solid line, SepLLM (n=64) in orange with a dashed line, SepLLM (n=64, H) in green with a solid line, SepLLM (n=64, H/T) in red with a solid line, and SepLLM (n=128) in purple with a solid line. All lines exhibit a similar trend, starting at a high value on the y-axis and decreasing as they move along the x-axis, with StrmLLM (n=64) beginning at approximately 1.1 and decreasing to around 0.4, SepLLM (n=64) starting at about 1 and decreasing to roughly 0.3, SepLLM (n=64, H) beginning at approximately 0.9 and decreasing to around 0.25, SepLLM (n=64, H/T) starting at about 0.85 and decreasing to roughly 0.2, and SepLLM (n=128) beginning at approximately 0.8 and decreasing to around 0.15, with shaded error bands around each line indicating variability. 

Each line is described in detail as follows: StrmLLM (n=64) decreases from approximately 1.1 to 0.4; SepLLM (n=64) decreases from about 1 to 0.3; SepLLM (n=64, H) decreases from 0.9 to 0.25; SepLLM (n=64, H/T) decreases from 0.85 to 0.2; SepLLM (n=128) decreases from 0.8 to 0.15.
